messages.text: Hi, two questions before I order. Do you ship the NerdQaxe++ to Canada, and how long is the lead time right now? Thanks, Abel
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04

Hi Abel,

Yes, we ship to Canada, with the North American plug and voltage.

The NerdQaxe++ is $249, but the North American version is out of stock right now, and that line runs about a 30 day lead time, so I don't have a firm ship date to give you today.

If you want the same 6 TH/s sooner, the Hammer Miner BC04 is $239, in stock, and ships in about 5 business days. It draws roughly 100W instead of 150W, and it has wired Ethernet as well as WiFi. The NerdQaxe++ wins on being fully open source and a little quieter, if that is what you are after.

Tell me which one and I will get it set up for you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
